name: Live Doom
author: slogonomo
description: A bot plays Doom live on your desktop and as your screensaver, until you click in and take over. Plays your own Doom games (Steam's DOOM + DOOM II is detected), the free shareware episode or Freedoom, with a Doom-styled settings menu, a live background you can add to any theme, and an SDK for writing your own bots. Needs a one-time native build: see the README.
